senses.gloss: अप्व mf(आ)n. abounding in water, MānGṛ.
अप्वा॑ (3; अ॑प्वा, Naigh.) f. ‘Impurity’, N. of a deity presiding over evacuation from fright, RV. x, 103, 12 (voc. अप्वे), AV. ix, 8, 9 (acc. अप्वा॑म्).
आप्वा nom. of आप्वन् m. ? (according to Siddh. ii, p. 393, l. 21, fr. √ आप्) wind, air (according to Comm. on Uṇ. i, 154 = कण्ठ-स्थान).
